shabad.source_english: Codes of Conduct and Other Panthic Sources

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਕੋ ਬਾਂਟ ਹੈ ਮਨ ਮੇਂ ਧਾਰੇ ਲੋਭ
verses.translit_en: jo prasaadh ko baa(n)T hai man me(n) dhaare lobh

en.bdb: One who distributes graced-pudding with avarice in his heart.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਿਸੇ ਥੋੜਾ ਕਿਸੇ ਅਗਲਾ ਸਦਾ ਰਹੇ ਤਿਸ ਸੋਗ। (੯)
verses.translit_en: kise thoRaa kise agalaa sadhaa rahe tis sog| (9)

en.bdb: More to some and scanty to others, he, forever, remains in affliction.(9)

verses.gurmukhi: ਕੜਾਹ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਕੀ ਬਿੱਧ ਸੁਣ ਲੀਜੈ
verses.translit_en: kaRaeh prasaadh kee bi'dh sun leejai

en.bdb: Listen to the procedure of preparing consecrated pudding.
Take three components in equal quantity.(10)
And using the scrubber, wash all the utensils.(11)
Then take the bath and come forward all clean,
And, except Vaheguru, the Almighty, utter nothing else.(12)
Take a pitcherful of fresh water,
Then, Gobind Singh says, he will be physically fit.(13)

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਤਿਆਰ ਚੌ ਕੀ ਪਰ ਧਰੇ
verses.translit_en: kar tiaar chau kee par dhare

en.bdb: After preparing it, place it on a stool,
With holy hymns flowing in all the four directions.(14)
